problem_statement: Build a brand-new Changelog page from scratch at the /changelog route of the DevZone admin (a Vite + React + MUI dashboard). The route does not exist yet. The page must live inside the standard sidebar layout and reuse the site's design system (MUI Container/Paper/Stack/Typography/Chip, the shared PageHeader component, the existing color tokens and Roboto/Rajdhani fonts). It should present the product's release history: a page title and intro, then a reverse-chronological list of release cards. Each release card shows its version, release date, a status chip (Latest / Stable / Patch), a one-line summary, and a breakdown of the concrete changes in that release grouped as Added / Improved / Fixed with individual bullet items. Also add a Changelog entry to the sidebar navigation.
required_content: A page title 'Changelog' rendered via the shared PageHeader (h1)
An intro paragraph starting 'Track every release' describing the page
Three release cards in reverse-chronological order: Version 2.4.0 (Latest), Version 2.3.0 (Stable), Version 2.2.0 (Patch)
Each release card shows the version as an h3 heading plus a status chip and a dated one-line summary
Version 2.4.0 lists concrete changes including 'Dark mode toggle in the top toolbar' and 'Dashboard charts now render 40% faster'
Version 2.3.0 lists concrete changes including 'Rich text editor for blog posts' and 'Recurring events in the calendar'
Version 2.2.0 lists concrete changes including 'Field-level validation messages on all forms'
Each release groups its changes under Added / Improved / Fixed headings
A Changelog item added to the sidebar navigation
The page renders inside the existing SidebarLayout and reuses the site design system (no horizontal overflow on mobile)
design_constraints: Reuse MUI components already used across the app: Container, Paper, Stack, Typography, Chip, Divider
Reuse the shared PageHeader component for the title + breadcrumbs
Use the existing theme color tokens (chip colors primary/success/warning, text.secondary) and the app's Roboto/Rajdhani fonts
Match the spacing/elevation conventions of existing pages (e.g. Tasks/TodoList): Paper cards with px/py padding inside a Container, vertical Stack spacing
author_notes: SWAP: candidate netlify-templates/one-click-hugo-cms was a Hugo static site (mislabeled react); swapped to pbasiak__dev-fox-ui-mui-dashboard-theme (single-root vite+react+MUI, react-router-dom createBrowserRouter, NO basename/base, offline-safe local mock auth, self-hosted @fontsource fonts). 方案A: baseline lacks /changelog (explicit top-level empty <></> route so #root is blank, since this router has no catch-all); reference implements the full page; bad renders the shell + version headings but drops the entire Added/Improved/Fixed change breakdown, failing the item-level dom_assertions. Three source trees md5-distinct. T1: dom_assertions only, no interaction.
